basic_details.job_title: DCPU Ariyalur Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Counsellor and Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator Posts
basic_details.post_name: Counsellor and Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator
basic_details.short_information: District Child Protection Unit Ariyalur (DCPU Ariyalur) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released on 27th July 2026 on the official website https://ariyalur.nic.in. A total of 2 vacancies have been announced through the DCPU Ariyalur Recruitment 2026 for the posts of Counsellor and Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 42 years for all posts. Age relaxation rules will be as per government norms.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor degree in Social Work/Sociology/Psychology/Public Health/Counselling or PG Diploma in Counseling and Communication, 12th standard pass with computer knowledge
qualification.details: Counsellor: Bachelor degree in Social Work/Sociology/Psychology/Public Health/Counselling or PG Diploma in Counseling and Communication from a recognized university with 1 year of experience in child-related counseling work and computer knowledge. Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator: 12th standard pass or equivalent with computer knowledge. Preference to experienced candidates.

salary_details.details: Counsellor: Rs. 18,536/- Per Month Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator: Rs. 13,240/- Per Month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Ariyalur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://ariyalur.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Ariyalur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://ariyalur.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Ariyalur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DCPU Ariyalur Recruitment 2026 is 07 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Counsellor post in the District Child Protection Unit Ariyalur recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 12th standard or equivalent with computer knowledge. Preference will be given to experienced candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DCPU Ariyalur recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts in this recruitment is 42 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The Counsellor post offers a monthly salary of Rs. 18,536/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the DCPU Ariyalur Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection stages for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DCPU Ariyalur Recruitment 2026 includes Application Screening and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Child Protection Unit Ariyalur, which is https://ariyalur.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. Does the recruitment mention any experience requirement?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Counsellor post, 1 year of experience in child-related counselling work is required. For the Assistant Cum Data Entry Operator post, preference is given to experienced candidates.
